start_here: Say to your AI: "Join <the pursuit> at <address>, database <name>, as <login name>, with a password only I keep."
no_lists_because: The password lives in my own vault and the login in the pursuit's database; nothing else is kept.
instructions: 1. Get the database's address, its name and a login name from the pursuit's owner.
2. Run workflow:join-a-pursuit-with-a-password-only-i-keep with address, database, role and the name to keep it under.
3. Your computer makes the password and keeps the connection in your vault; nobody sees the password.
4. Send the owner the role and the verifier it answers; they run workflow:let-a-person-into-a-pursuit.
5. Connect with the connection you kept.

worked_examples.title: Join a club's database
worked_examples.ask: Join the club database at db.example.org:5432 as sam_coach.
worked_examples.given: Nothing is kept under club-database-connection yet.
worked_examples.hands_back: kept_as "club-database-connection", hosts ["db.example.org"]; then role "sam_coach" and password_verifier "SCRAM-SHA-256$4096:..." to send; said "Sent sam_coach and its verifier to the club's owner."
